facts: The facility is a horse-riding center in Songdang-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju.
It offers five riding-course choices: basic, middle-distance, long-distance, walking, and one-hour free riding.
Typical riding time is about 15 to 20 minutes; staff lead the horse during the ride, and beginners aged 10 or over can participate.
The page describes it as riding across Gujwa fields and records a photo line, free vest/boots/hat rental, and a small snack-and-coffee shop.
The TourAPI-linked public record identifies Songdang Horse Riding Center as a Jeju horse-riding experience with courses from short-distance and walking courses to one-hour free riding.
